status: preimplementation acceptance specification; not measured passes
origin: Engineering acceptance choices, not claimed universal perceptual thresholds. Freeze before tuning; validate independent positive and negative controls.
time_convention: Bars are elapsed 4/4 mix bars from verified phrase origin; bar 0 is the origin. Source pickups precede their annotated downbeats.
change_policy: Versioned change with independently reviewed reference evidence, before retuning; rerun baseline and controls. Candidate performance alone is not justification.

beat_alignment.window: Every sustained hook/overlap; onset errors on each annotated beat; report worst 16-bar window and complete span
beat_alignment.limit: Realized mapped tempos differ <=0.1%; p95 onset error <=20 ms, maximum <=40 ms; cumulative first-to-last drift <=20 ms per 16 bars
beat_alignment.exception: Expressive source timing requires independent per-beat annotation; test mapping against that grid, never inferred candidate grid. Native short chops tested separately.

live_export_parity.window: Actual engine capture and export at 128, 256, 1024 frames; every event, transition +/-8 bars and full render
live_export_parity.limit: After one independently measured constant device/codec latency correction, event onset error <=2 ms, accumulated end drift <=2 ms, 400ms loudness envelope difference <=0.5 LU (100ms hop)
live_export_parity.exception: Stochastic/modulated tails may differ samplewise; timing and loudness tolerances remain. Missing live capture is inconclusive.

join_loudness.window: Ungated BS.1770 K-weighted 400ms windows, 100ms hop, every join +/-4 bars; reference medians 2 bars before/after excluding annotated transition. Log short-term 3s loudness too.
join_loudness.limit: Neutral joins: no unplanned trough >3 LU below the quieter reference for >=200ms; no overshoot >3 LU above louder reference for >=200ms. Adjacent steady passages within 2 LU after normalization.
join_loudness.exception: Independently annotated build/break/void has an explicit pre-render loudness envelope and +/-2 LU tolerance; exception interval only, never whole title/join labels.

limiter.window: Actual mix-bus gain-reduction telemetry per <=10ms frame, every 1-second rolling window and entire render
limiter.limit: No reduction >3 dB sustained >=500ms; <=1% of program time above 3dB; maximum reduction <=6dB
limiter.exception: None; missing telemetry is inconclusive. Meter cannot be inferred from output waveform.

peak_headroom.window: Whole pre-SFX bus and whole post-master PCM plus decoded delivery encode; true peak >=4x oversampling
peak_headroom.limit: Pre-SFX sample peak <=-6dBFS; output true peak <=-1.0dBTP; no clipped PCM samples
peak_headroom.exception: None; encoded overshoot requires rendering headroom, not waived clipping.

silence.window: 20ms RMS windows with 10ms hop; internal program excluding source-supported ending decay
silence.limit: No unowned interval below -60dBFS lasting >=50ms while mapped source is above -45dBFS; run separate loudness gate for shallower holes
silence.exception: Preannotated non-pivot void exactly one mix beat +/-2ms. Pivot has no void. Source silence must match original source interval and duration.

native_chop.window: Every incompatible guest event and rolling 8 mix bars
native_chop.limit: Duration <=min(60/BPM,0.75) seconds; max2 events/8 bars; no repetition, foreground lead conflict or kick/bass contribution; breakdown/outro after Drop1 only
native_chop.exception: No exception; longer cameos are sustained hooks and require tempo/key eligibility.

required_evidence: Missing measurement, decoder, telemetry, annotation or required audition = inconclusive, never pass.
